name: Drum Beating

flavor_text: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

name: Snap Trap

flavor_text: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

name: Pyro Ball

flavor_text: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: Behemoth Blade
short_effect: Deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
flavor_text: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

name: Behemoth Bash
short_effect: Deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
flavor_text: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

name: Aura Wheel
short_effect: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type.
flavor_text: The user attacks with energy from its cheeks, increasing its movement speed and boosting its Attack stat for a short time. This move's type changes based on Morpeko's form.

name: Breaking Swipe
short_effect: Lowers the target's Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
flavor_text: The user attacks by wildly swinging its tough tail. This also lowers targets' Attack stats for a short time.

name: Branch Poke
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor_text: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

name: Overdrive
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor_text: The user attacks targets by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

name: Apple Acid
short_effect: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: Grav Apple
short_effect: Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect.
flavor_text: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

name: Spirit Break
short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target's Special Attack by one stage.
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

name: Strange Steam
short_effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
flavor_text: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

name: Life Dew
short_effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
flavor_text: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

name: Obstruct
short_effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn. If this blocks a contact move, the user has their Defense lowered by 2 stages.
flavor_text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker's Defense stat.

name: False Surrender
short_effect: Never misses.
flavor_text: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

name: Meteor Assault
short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
flavor_text: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. However, this also makes the user stagger, leaving it unable to move for a short time.

name: Eternabeam
short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
flavor_text: This is Eternatus's most powerful attack in its original form. The user can't move on the next turn.

name: Steel Beam
short_effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
flavor_text: The user attacks by firing off a fierce beam of steel that has been collected from its entire body. The user will also take some damage.

name: Expanding Force
short_effect: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

name: Steel Roller
short_effect: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.
flavor_text: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

name: Scale Shot
short_effect: Boosts the user's Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.
flavor_text: The user attacks by shooting out five volleys of scales, one after the other. This increases the user's movement speed but also lowers its Defense stat for a short time.

name: Meteor Beam
short_effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.
flavor_text: The user attacks with energy gathered from space. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat for a while. This move takes some time to carry out.

name: Shell Side Arm
short_effect: Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target.
flavor_text: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.

name: Misty Explosion
short_effect: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%.
flavor_text: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.

name: Grassy Glide
short_effect: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.
flavor_text: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

name: Rising Voltage
short_effect: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.
flavor_text: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.

name: Terrain Pulse
short_effect: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.
flavor_text: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

name: Skitter Smack
short_effect: Lowers the target's Special Attack by one stage.
flavor_text: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

name: Burning Jealousy
short_effect: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.
flavor_text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

name: Lash Out
short_effect: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
flavor_text: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

name: Poltergeist
short_effect: Fails if the target has no held item.
flavor_text: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

name: Corrosive Gas
short_effect: Target drops its held item.
flavor_text: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

name: Coaching
short_effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
flavor_text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

name: Flip Turn
short_effect: User must switch out after attacking.
flavor_text: The user attacks by dishing out a quick blow, then rushes back to its Trainer with incredible speed.

name: Triple Axel
short_effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.
flavor_text: The user attacks with three kicks, one after the other. The range of these attacks grow wider each time the user jumps up to unleash a kick.

name: Dual Wingbeat
short_effect: Hits twice in one turn.
flavor_text: The user attacks by slamming targets with its wings to deal two strikes, one after the other.

name: Scorching Sands
short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
flavor_text: The user attacks by throwing scorching sand at targets. This may also leave targets with a burn.

name: Jungle Healing
short_effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.
flavor_text: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

name: Wicked Blow
short_effect: Always scores a critical hit.
flavor_text: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

name: Surging Strikes
short_effect: Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit.
flavor_text: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

name: Thunder Cage
short_effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
flavor_text: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

name: Dragon Energy
short_effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
flavor_text: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

name: Freezing Glare
short_effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
flavor_text: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

name: Fiery Wrath
short_effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
flavor_text: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

name: Thunderous Kick
short_effect: Lowers the target's Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
flavor_text: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

name: Glacial Lance
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor_text: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

name: Astral Barrage
short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
flavor_text: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

name: Eerie Spell
short_effect: The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used.
flavor_text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.

name: Dire Claw
flavor_text: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

name: Psyshield Bash
flavor_text: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user's Defense stat.

name: Power Shift
flavor_text: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

name: Stone Axe
flavor_text: The user attacks by swinging its stone axes at targets. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the targets.

name: Springtide Storm
flavor_text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

name: Mystical Power
flavor_text: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: Raging Fury
flavor_text: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

name: Wave Crash
flavor_text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

name: Chloroblast
flavor_text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

name: Mountain Gale
flavor_text: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

name: Victory Dance

name: Headlong Rush
flavor_text: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: Barb Barrage
flavor_text: The user attacks by launching countless toxic barbs, which may also poison targets. This move's power is doubled if a target is already poisoned.

name: Esper Wing
flavor_text: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

name: Bitter Malice
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

name: Shelter
flavor_text: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

name: Triple Arrows
flavor_text: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target's Defense stat or make it flinch.

name: Infernal Parade
flavor_text: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

name: Ceaseless Edge
flavor_text: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

name: Bleakwind Storm
flavor_text: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

name: Wildbolt Storm

name: Sandsear Storm
flavor_text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

name: Lunar Blessing
flavor_text: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

name: Take Heart
flavor_text: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

name: Silk Trap
flavor_text: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

name: Axe Kick
flavor_text: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: Last Respects
flavor_text: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

name: Lumina Crash
flavor_text: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: Order Up
flavor_text: The user attacks with roguish poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

name: Jet Punch
flavor_text: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Spicy Extract
flavor_text: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, which boosts targets' Attack stats but also lowers their Defense stats for a while.

name: Spin Out
flavor_text: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

name: Population Bomb
flavor_text: The user's fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

name: Ice Spinner
flavor_text: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

name: Glaive Rush
flavor_text: The user attacks by throwing its entire body into a reckless charge. However, the user is left wide open and unable to move for a short time.

name: Revival Blessing
flavor_text: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

name: Salt Cure
flavor_text: The user attacks by salt-curing targets to inflict continual damage. Water and Steel types are more strongly affected by this move.

name: Triple Dive
flavor_text: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

name: Mortal Spin
flavor_text: The user attacks by spinning about. This leaves targets poisoned and also increases the user's movement speed for a short time.

name: Doodle
flavor_text: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

name: Fillet Away
flavor_text: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

name: Kowtow Cleave
flavor_text: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

name: Flower Trick
flavor_text: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

name: Torch Song
flavor_text: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: Aqua Step
flavor_text: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

name: Raging Bull
flavor_text: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

name: Make It Rain
flavor_text: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat for a short time. If a target is successfully struck, you will earn money.

name: Psyblade
flavor_text: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

name: Hydro Steam
flavor_text: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

name: Ruination
flavor_text: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target's HP in half.

name: Collision Course
flavor_text: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

name: Electro Drift
flavor_text: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

name: Shed Tail
flavor_text: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before rushing back to its Trainer. This also increases the user's movement speed for a while.

name: Chilly Reception
flavor_text: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

name: Tidy Up
flavor_text: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats.

name: Snowscape
flavor_text: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

name: Pounce
flavor_text: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

name: Trailblaze
flavor_text: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork also increases its movement speed for a short time.

name: Chilling Water
flavor_text: The user attacks targets by showering them with water that's so cold it saps their power. This also lowers targets' Attack stats for a short time.

name: Hyper Drill
flavor_text: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

name: Twin Beam
flavor_text: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

name: Rage Fist
flavor_text: The user attacks by converting its rage into energy. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater this move's power.

name: Armor Cannon
flavor_text: The user attacks by shooting off its own armor as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats for a short time.

name: Bitter Blade
flavor_text: The user attacks by focusing all its bitter feelings toward this world into the tip of its blade. The user's HP will be restored by a portion of the damage dealt.

name: Double Shock
flavor_text: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

name: Gigaton Hammer
flavor_text: The user attacks by swinging its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move cannot be used again for a short time after the blow is dealt.

name: Comeuppance
flavor_text: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

name: Aqua Cutter
flavor_text: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

name: Blood Moon
flavor_text: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

name: Matcha Gotcha
flavor_text: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: Syrup Bomb
flavor_text: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

name: Ivy Cudgel
flavor_text: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

name: Electro Shot
flavor_text: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

name: Tera Starstorm
flavor_text: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

name: Fickle Beam
flavor_text: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

name: Burning Bulwark
flavor_text: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

name: Thunderclap
flavor_text: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

name: Mighty Cleave
flavor_text: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: Tachyon Cutter
flavor_text: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

name: Hard Press
flavor_text: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

name: Dragon Cheer
flavor_text: The user raises its allies' morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

name: Alluring Voice
flavor_text: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

name: Temper Flare
flavor_text: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

name: Supercell Slam
flavor_text: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: Psychic Noise
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

name: Upper Hand
flavor_text: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

name: Malignant Chain
flavor_text: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

name: Nihil Light
flavor_text: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.
